  "question": "Has Eastmere Debt Office's operating change resolved the question about real yield? Focus on: The ten-year real yield at September month-end and its change from August month-end.",
  "gap": "The ten-year real yield at September month-end and its change from August month-end.",
  "passages": [
    "The useful comparison depends on keeping the time window, unit and population consistent.

The Debt Office fixing sheet gives ten-year real yields of 1.3% on 30 September and 1.0% on 31 August, an increase of 30 basis points.

Background to the observation: Eastmere issued inflation-linked bonds with a ten-year tenor.

A comparison should use the same unit on both sides. A percentage-point change is different from a percentage change. A nameplate limit is also different from measured delivery under operating conditions.

SYNTHETIC benchmark article. People, records and quantities in this standalone research fixture are invented."
  ]
}
